parsed.why: Strong state shield, gender-neutral facilities and anti-discrimination rules lower local exposure; national passport, border and federal facility risks still dominate.
No adult facility ban or shield; protections patchy, youth-sports pressure, and outside municipalities little recourse. Close to national baseline, lightly mitigated.
State-building and school facility ban creates universal traveler exposure; no state antidiscrimination or hate recourse, and religious service denial. Below national.
Shield law explicitly covers outside travelers seeking care, gender-neutral facilities, broad protections, no local ban; national border/custody exposure remains severe.
Birth-sex rules for facilities, shelters, prisons, documents and public healthcare funding create layered universal exposure with no state recourse; far below national.
